critique: The render has the core preset language: luminous magenta/pink diagonal particle strings on black, with fine secondary strands and some fractal breakup. However, it reads more as a set of broad, nearly parallel light bars than a controlled fractal-line field. The composition is very uneven across time: frame 1 is mostly empty black with a few isolated streak groups, while frame 4 becomes heavily packed and clips into a very bright central-right mass. The motion between frames is therefore an excessive lateral sweep/repopulation rather than a more consistently distributed evolving fractal texture.

suggestions.why: Reduce the extreme fractal-flow displacement so the line field evolves without sweeping most of the composition from sparse to overloaded.
Lower dispersion to keep the strings visually related as a fractal line structure and reduce the large empty-black gaps between clusters.
Slow the evolution phase so brightness and line placement change more smoothly between sampled times instead of producing a drastic composition shift.
